description: Book a same-day delivery for a WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix Stores or Squarespace order by its number (e.g. #1042) or id. Pickup is the store location, drop-off the order's shipping address, items from the line items. Fetches the order from the platform if the connector has not seen it. force=true ignores the store's radius and size limits. On success the order is marked shipped / fulfilled with a tracking link as the driver picks it up.

order.description: Order number like #1042, the platform's order id, or the connector's order row id

store.description: Store id, URL or key when several stores of that platform are connected

name: book_store_order
title: Book a store order
